capacity.ipam_pool: usable IPv4 addresses exclude the subnet network, broadcast, gateway and auxiliary addresses, then subtract other occupied endpoints
capacity.runtime_count: all attached managed Runtime endpoints across scopes
capacity.runtime_capacity: total Runtime slots including occupied runtimes, not remaining slots

egress_restart.notice: best-effort authenticated inner frame; abrupt failure sends no notice
egress_restart.while_draining: no new flows; existing flows serviced to the deadline then dropped at process exit
egress_restart.persistence: flows and NAT state are not persisted
egress_restart.old_consumers: ignore the frame as a valid TCP packet that may be written to TUN; no unsupported-revision signal

wire.transport: encrypted by the existing Peer session; parsed only from authenticated Event::Ipv4 plaintext, never raw UDP, never written to TUN by the notice path, and grants no workload-credential or binding authority
